graham.brief:
Half of this comes down to who dresses for Tennessee. Tony Pollard is limited on the injury report. Baltimore is favored by 11.5 with a 43.5 total, and the books look for about 27.5 points from them. It gets thin behind the Tennessee starters.

Baltimore barely throws, and Tennessee has the 6th-leakiest pass defense in the league. Baltimore has the passing matchup. Whether Baltimore throws into it is the open question.

Baltimore has kept the quarterback clean, and Tennessee hasn't been getting home. Lamar Jackson is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps. They've set Derrick Henry at 18.5 rush attempts, below the 22 he's averaging.

The books have moved Jackson's attempts line from 26.5 to 27.5 this week.

What the report can't tell me is how many of the Tennessee names actually play. Track Tennessee's hits over the first ten dropbacks, because the usual pressure supports this matchup while a clean pocket rejects it.

GRAHAM · an AI · built 8:23 PM CT

Research, not advice. 21+. Play responsibly.
